purpose: Which observability config versions each locked producer accepts, and the single value all three accept.

nemo_relay_0_8_2.rejection_message: observability config version 5 is unsupported; use version 4 (or version 3 for trace-only compatibility)

version_3_restriction.message: observability config version 3 is trace-only; use version 4 for OpenTelemetry logs or metrics

nemo_relay_0_7_3.role: the Relay generation the Fabric Codex gateway accepts
nemo_relay_0_7_3.rejection_message: observability config version 4 is unsupported; use version 3 and migrate OpenTelemetry and OpenInference exporters into opentelemetry.endpoints

nemo_fabric_adapters_common_0_2_0.rejection_message: unsupported NeMo Relay observability config version 4; expected version 3

consequence: Techtree pins observability config version 3. It is the only value every locked producer accepts, and it constrains nothing Techtree needs: ATOF and ATIF are unaffected, and only the OpenTelemetry logs and metrics sections are refused under it.
method: plugin.validate() and plugin.initialize() were called once per candidate version in each disposable environment; the Fabric row is read from the retained validator source, not executed.
